keyFindings.description: Red in envoy-go-race at the code head. Since 299ac590 a note brings a waiting room's check forward, and quickCompactionQueue's timing leaves firstCheck at 0, so the notes of writes 20-21 (lines 60-62) move the parked check to now and the queue can compact the document before the test reads `before` (line 64) and `from` (line 68). The await at line 70 then waits for a second compaction that never comes. The test must capture `from` before those writes, or hold the queue (pause) across them, so it is deterministic under -race.
